statement:
∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    T2Space (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ∧
      T2Space (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ∧ ¬DiscreteTopology (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
script:
# name: set-two-hausdorff-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Hausdorff.two_hausdorff_topologies
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1', '(by norm_num)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n), T2Space (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ∧ @T2Space (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ⊥ ∧ ¬ DiscreteTopology (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
  intro n hn
  refine ⟨inferInstance, by letI : TopologicalSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := ⊥; haveI : DiscreteTopology (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := ⟨rfl⟩; infer_instance, fun h => ?_⟩
  haveI : Nontrivial (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, hn⟩⟩
    infer_instance
  exact not_isOpen_singleton (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (isOpen_discrete _)
exact @key (1) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['2', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n), T2Space (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ∧ @T2Space (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ⊥ ∧ ¬ DiscreteTopology (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
  intro n hn
  refine ⟨inferInstance, by letI : TopologicalSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := ⊥; haveI : DiscreteTopology (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := ⟨rfl⟩; infer_instance, fun h => ?_⟩
  haveI : Nontrivial (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, hn⟩⟩
    infer_instance
  exact not_isOpen_singleton (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (isOpen_discrete _)
exact @key (2) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['3', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n), T2Space (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ∧ @T2Space (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ⊥ ∧ ¬ DiscreteTopology (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
  intro n hn
  refine ⟨inferInstance, by letI : TopologicalSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := ⊥; haveI : DiscreteTopology (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := ⟨rfl⟩; infer_instance, fun h => ?_⟩
  haveI : Nontrivial (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, hn⟩⟩
    infer_instance
  exact not_isOpen_singleton (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (isOpen_discrete _)
exact @key (3) ((by norm_num))'),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]
